desc: Compute arrays $Q$ where $Q_i = P_i + A_i$ for $1 \le i < N$, and $R$ where $R_j = P_j - A_j$ for $2 \le j \le N$.
Perform coordinate compression on all values in $Q$ and $R$ to map them to ranks $1 \dots M$.
Implement a Segment Tree (or Fenwick Tree) that supports point updates and range maximum/minimum queries.
Build a Segment Tree over the compressed values of $Q$ to store the maximum original index for a given value range.
Iterate $K$ from $1$ to $N$: Query the tree for the largest index $i < K$ such that $Q_i \ge P_K$. Calculate `left_sum`.
Build a Segment Tree over the compressed values of $R$ to store the minimum original index for a given value range.
